sandbachFocus: Sandbach United face Ashby Ivanhoe in the FA Vase 1st Qualifying Round on Saturday 15 August at 15:00, marking their cup competition this period. After a mixed league start with two wins and a loss, the Ramblers will be looking to make their mark in the cup competition. Recent midweek action saw them fall 3-2 at Foley Meir despite creating numerous chances, but they bounced back with a 1-0 home league victory over Stafford Town.
divisionWide: Wolverhampton Casuals continue their impressive form as league leaders (P3 W3) with a home fixture against Dawley Town at 15:00 Saturday. Second-place AFC Bridgnorth (P2 W2) host Crewe at 15:00 Saturday, both sides unbeaten so far. Brereton Social (P2 W2) travel away to face Bilston Town at 15:00 Saturday in what should be a competitive clash between two strong starts. New Mills (P3 W2 D0 L1) host the struggling Shawbury United (P3 W1 D1 L1) at 15:00 Saturday. Eccleshall face a midweek cup tie against high-flying Wolverhampton Casuals on Wednesday, while several teams including Telford Town, Cheadle Heath Nomads, and Market Drayton Town compete in cup competitions. The division's bottom sides—Widnes Town, Alsager Town, and Allscott Heath—all have fixtures to climb the table.
